name: Configure GitHub Pages
description: A GitHub Action to enable Pages, extract various metadata about a site, and configure some supported static site generators.

static_site_generator.description: Optional static site generator to attempt to configure: "nuxt", "next", "gatsby", or "sveltekit"

generator_config_file.description: Optional file path to static site generator configuration file
